tagline.en: The southern half of the Twin Cities beltway

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-94 at Maple Grove, north-west of Minneapolis
start.zh: 明尼阿波利斯西北的梅普尔格罗夫，与 I-94 相接

end.en: I-94 at Woodbury, east of Saint Paul
end.zh: 圣保罗以东的伍德伯里，与 I-94 相接

en: I-494 is the southern and western half of the beltway around Minneapolis and Saint Paul; I-694 is the northern half, and together they make a ring with both ends on I-94. The even hundreds digit is doing what it should — I-494 leaves its parent in Maple Grove and rejoins it in Woodbury, having gone the long way round through Plymouth, Minnetonka, Eden Prairie, Bloomington and Eagan.

The busiest part is the stretch across Bloomington and Richfield known locally as the Bloomington Strip, which passes the Mall of America, the Minneapolis–Saint Paul airport and a long chain of office parks. MnDOT counts about 130,000 vehicles a day there and calls it one of the most heavily congested roads in the state. The road is now at least three lanes each way for its whole length, the last widening having been finished in Plymouth in November 2016.
zh: I-494 是环绕明尼阿波利斯与圣保罗那条环线的南半环与西半环；北半环是 I-694，两者合起来构成一个环，两端都接在 I-94 上。偶数百位在这里履行了它的职责——I-494 在梅普尔格罗夫离开母线，绕经普利茅斯、明尼通卡、伊登普雷里、布卢明顿与伊根，最后在伍德伯里重新汇入。
最繁忙的是横穿布卢明顿与里奇菲尔德的那一段，当地人称之为「布卢明顿带」，沿途经过美国购物中心、明尼阿波利斯－圣保罗国际机场，以及一长串办公园区。明尼苏达州交通部统计该处每日约 130,000 辆，并称其为全州最拥堵的道路之一。如今全线每向至少三条车道，最后一次拓宽于 2016 年 11 月在普利茅斯完成。

en: Construction began in the late 1950s and the ring was not closed until 1985. The Bloomington Strip came first and it was overloaded almost at once: the section between Highway 100 and Highway 5 opened in 1959 and had to be widened east of Highway 100 within ten years. The rest of the strip followed — Highway 169 to Highway 100 in 1961, Highway 5 to Highway 169 in 1963 — and it has been rebuilt piecemeal ever since, with interchange reconstructions and widenings in 1965, 1984, 1988, 2002 and 2003.

The current work is the largest of them. MnDOT split its long-term plan for I-494 between Highway 169 and the airport into two construction projects of $377 million each: the first, adding E-ZPass lanes between Highway 100 and I-35W along with a new interchange ramp and three replacement bridges, runs from spring 2023 to autumn 2026; the second is programmed for 2027 to 2030. A separate $62 million job on the 43-year-old bridge over the Minnesota River runs to summer 2026.
zh: 工程始于 1950 年代末，环线直到 1985 年才合圈。布卢明顿带最先建成，也几乎立刻就超载了：100 号公路与 5 号公路之间的路段 1959 年通车，不到十年就得在 100 号公路以东拓宽。其余各段随后跟进——169 号公路至 100 号公路为 1961 年，5 号公路至 169 号公路为 1963 年——此后一直在零敲碎打地改造，1965、1984、1988、2002 与 2003 年都有立交重建或拓宽。

眼下的工程是其中规模最大的。明尼苏达州交通部把 169 号公路至机场之间 I-494 的长期方案拆成两个各 3.77 亿美元的建设项目：第一个在 100 号公路与 I-35W 之间增设 E-ZPass 车道，并新建一条立交匝道及三座重建桥梁，工期自 2023 年春至 2026 年秋；第二个计划在 2027 至 2030 年间实施。另有一项 6,200 万美元的工程，针对跨明尼苏达河那座已服役 43 年的桥梁，将持续到 2026 年夏。
